description: 🎬 @scenejs/timeline is a component that represents the timeline of Scene.js. You can control time, properties, and items.
readme: Scene.js Timeline @scenejs/timeline is a component that represents the timeline of Scene.jsYou can control time, properties, and items. Scene.js / Example ⚙️ Installation $ npm i @scenejs/timeline <script src="https://daybrush.com/scenejs-timeline/release/latest/dist/timeline.pkgd.min.js"></script> 🚀 How to use import Scene from "scenejs"; import Timeline, { SelectEvent } from "@scenejs/timeline"; const scene = new Scene({ ... }); const timeline = new Timeline(scene, document.body, { keyboard: true, }); timeline.on("select", (e: SelectEvent) => { console.log(e.selectedItem); }); 📦 Packages react-scenejs-timeline: A React Component that control scene.js timeline. preact-timeline: A Preact Component that control scene.js timeline. ⭐️ Show Your Support Please give a ⭐️ if this project helped you! 👏 Contributing If you have any questions or requests or want to contribute to scenejs-timeline or other packages, please write the issue or give me a Pull Request freely. 🐞 Bug Report If you find a bug, please report to us opening a new Issue on GitHub. 📝 License This project is MIT licensed.
